title: Tape Clearing Machine
statement: Given a natural number $k$, a work-tape index $i<k$, and any symbol alphabet, define a machine with sweep, rewind, and done states. In the sweep state, it moves the head on tape $i$ right while that head scans a symbol; when it scans blank, it moves that head left and enters rewind. In rewind, it erases the scanned cell and moves left while the head scans a symbol; when it scans blank, it moves right and enters done. All other work-tape heads remain stationary, and in done the machine makes no changes or movements.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a work-tape index less than $k$
The machine uses an arbitrary symbol alphabet
